s.p.everywhere.paper_d: Ufata ifoto y’inyandiko cyangwa ifishi, ukayisoma mu ndimi yawe
s.p.voyage.bk_esim_d: eSIM: ihuza mu gihe ugeze ku kibuga cy’indege
s.p.voyage.bk_note: Amahuza y'abafatanyabikorwa: buri rugendo rushobora kuguha 24/24 ONE WORLD kuri komisiyo, nta mafaranga asanzwe utanga.Ibi bifasha mu gushyigikira ikoranabuhanga ridashingiye ku matsinda.
s.p.espaces.community_sub: Imiryango idafite imipaka y’ururimi: buri wese akoresha ururimi rwe, buri wese asoma mu rurimi rwe.
s.p.espaces.live_sub: Amashusho y’ibiganiro mu rurimi rwawe: subtitles zihinduwe, n’amajwi yahinduwe niba ushaka.
s.p.espaces.business_sub: Ubukungu bw’isi yose: ugurishe, ugura, ubone umucuruzi, ukoreshe serivisi, ungana n’abandi… buri rubuga rugaragara mu Kinyarwanda.
s.p.espaces.avantages_sub: Icyo 24/24 ONE WORLD kiguha ku rwego rwo hejuru.
s.p.espaces.none_c: Nta miryango ihari. Niba ushaka kuba uwa mbere, urebe hano!
s.p.espaces.none_l: Nta kiganiro kirimo kugeza ubu. Gutangira icya mbere!
s.p.espaces.empty_room: Nta butumwa kugeza ubu. Gutangira ikiganiro!
s.p.espaces.live_host_hint: Speaking: Ingingo zawe zigaragara nka subtitles, zihindurwa ku bantu bose.
s.p.espaces.live_watch: Ushobora kwinjira ngo urebe camera n’ukoreshe uburyo bwo kwandika.
s.p.espaces.live_mic_denied: Microphone bloquée: ushobora kuyikoresha mu mikorere y'urubuga rwawe.
s.p.espaces.live_no_mic: Iyi porogaramu yo gushakisha ntishobora kugenzura: kanda hano ukoreshe inyandiko yawe.
s.p.espaces.cam_fail: Kamera ntiyihari: ikoreshwe mu mikorere y'umukoresha wawe.
s.p.espaces.b_kind_wholesale: Nkora ibicuruzwa ku giciro cyo hejuru (umucuruzi, umwanditsi)
s.p.espaces.b_kind_logistics: Gutwara, gutwara ibicuruzwa, imicungire y’ibicuruzwa (guha cyangwa gushaka)
s.p.espaces.b_kind_customs: Urwego rw’imisoro n’amahoro, umucuruzi w’ibicuruzwa, import-export (gutanga cyangwa gushaka)
s.p.espaces.rg_d: Imikoreshereze y’imipaka, amabwiriza ku bicuruzwa, gutangira ubucuruzi, imbuga nkoranyambaga z’ishoramari: ibisubizo bya buri gihugu.
s.p.espaces.rg_sub: Itegeko rihinduka rimwe na rimwe: ONE WORLD ntiririkora, ifungura ibisubizo by’inyandiko z’umunsi ku munsi, urabisoma mu Kinyarwanda.
s.p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): ku musaruro n’igihugu, imisoro, amahoro, amabwiriza n’imyitwarire byose biboneka ku rubuga rumwe
s.p.espaces.rg_g2: Map Access Market (ITC): imisoro y’imipaka n’amabwiriza y’ubwoko
s.p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): amabwiriza, ibiciro n’amabwiriza y’ubuziranenge aya gihugu ashyiraho ku bicuruzwa
s.p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: gukora ubucuruzi n’ibihugu by’u Burayi, ntambwe ku yindi
s.p.espaces.rg_e2: Taric: code de douane et droits d’entrée dans l’UE
s.p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (Banque Mondiale): gushinga uruganda, imisoro, ubucuruzi mpuzamahanga, igihugu ku gihugu
s.p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): kureba niba porogaramu itagaragajwe n’umugenzuzi mbere yo kuyiha amafaranga
s.p.espaces.rg_note: Ushobora gufungura urubuga mu rurimi rwawe: ukoresha uburyo bwo guhindura rw’ikoranabuhanga ryawe, cyangwa « Gusobanukirwa inyandiko » mu gihe uri gusoma inyandiko.
s.p.espaces.rg_ask: Niba ushaka kumenya byinshi kuri Markets
s.p.espaces.cu_d: Imisoro, dosiye, Incoterms, ibikoresho by’akazi bihendutse, abagenzi n’abatwara.
s.p.espaces.cu_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD ntiyishyurira inyandiko z’itangwa ry’amadolari: umucuruzi w’amadolari ufite uruhushya rwo gutwara ibicuruzwa (freight forwarder) ashobora kubigufashamo.
s.p.espaces.cu_t1: Map Access Market (ITC, UN-WTO): inshingano n’amabwiriza ya buri gihugu
s.p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (Union Européenne): imisoro, inyungu, amategeko y’ubwoko, urugendo rurerure
s.p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: code de douane (code HS) et droits d’entrée dans l’Union européenne
s.p.espaces.cu_d3: Inyandiko z’ingendo: inyandiko y’ingendo (mu mazi), inyandiko y’ingendo mu kirere (mu kirere), CMR (mu muhanda)
s.p.espaces.cu_d5: Nimero ya EORI (ibigo bicuruza cyangwa bitumiza mu mahanga muri EU)
s.p.espaces.cu_d6: Ku bijyanye n’umusaruro: ibyemezo by’ubuziranenge, ibyangombwa, amabwiriza ya CE
s.p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: umuguzi acunga byose kuva mu ruganda rw'umucuruzi.
s.p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: Umucuruzi ashyikiriza ibicuruzwa umushoferi w’umuguzi, nyuma y’uko bimaze gukorerwa isuzuma ry’ubuziranenge.
s.p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: Umucuruzi ashyira ibicuruzwa ku modoka; nyuma yaho, abaguzi nibo bafata ibyago n’ibiciro.
s.p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: Umucuruzi agomba kwishyura ingendo n’ubwishingizi kugeza ku mupaka w’aho ibicuruzwa biva.
s.p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Umucuruzi ashyikiriza ibicuruzwa aho bigomba kugezwa, umuguzi agatanga imisoro y’inganda.
s.p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: Umucuruzi agomba kwishyura byose, harimo n'imisoro y'icuruzwa.
s.p.espaces.cu_ban: Ibicuruzwa bitemewe cyangwa bigenzurwa hose: intwaro, ibiyobyabwenge, imipira y’amabuye y’agaciro, ibikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga, imiti, ibindi bikomoka ku nyamaswa (CITES), n’ibindi.
s.p.espaces.cu_src: Inkomoko: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, Komisiyo y’Ubumwe bw’u Burayi, douane.gouv.fr.
s.p.espaces.b_kind_mission: Akazi cyangwa akazi gato (guha cyangwa gushakisha)
s.p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly… ugereranye ibiciro byo mu gihugu cyawe mbere yo kohereza amafaranga.
s.p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD ntiyiha amafaranga yonyine kandi ntacyo ibona kuri aya ma linki: ugereranya hano, nyuma uha amafaranga n'uburyo wifuza.
s.p.espaces.mt_wb: Kugura no kuguriza mu mahanga (Banque Mondiale): inyungu nyakuri yo gutumiza amafaranga, igihugu ku gihugu, serivisi ku servisi
s.p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Kuzana amafaranga mu ntoki muri benshi mu bihugu, kwishyura kuri terefoni, kwishyura kuri telefone
s.p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Kuzana amafaranga mu ntoki, kwishyura kuri banki, mobile wallet
s.p.espaces.mt_p_ria: Kuzana amafaranga mu ntoki, transfert bancaire
s.p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Kwinjira muri banki ku kiguzi c’umugabane, amafranga agaragara mbere y’uko utumiza
s.p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Ihererekanya ry'amafaranga, porogaramu y'ikoranabuhanga, kwishyura mu ntoki
s.p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallet, transfert ya banki, kwishyura mu ntoki
s.p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Kwiyandikisha ku mobile wallet cyangwa kuri konti ya banki
s.p.espaces.mt_k1: Reba umubare w’amafaranga wahawe: amafranga + inyungu y’ihinduka ry’umutungo.Inyungu mbi kurusha inyungu y’ihinduka ry’umutungo ni igihombo gikomeye.
s.p.espaces.mt_k2: Guhitamo uko umuntu azajya abihabwa: mu ntoki, kuri konti ya banki cyangwa muri porogaramu ya Mobile Money (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN…).
s.p.espaces.mt_k3: Inyandiko y’indangamuntu ni ngombwa cyane, haba mu gutumiza no mu kwishyuza.
s.p.espaces.mt_k4: Ntabwo ukwiye kohereza amafaranga ku muntu wahuye na we kuri interineti gusa, cyangwa ngo "ufungure" igihembo, impapuro, inguzanyo cyangwa visa: ni ikinyoma.
s.p.espaces.mt_note: Ibikorwa n’ibiciro bihinduka: ujye ubanza ukareba ku rubuga rwabo mbere yo kohereza.
s.p.espaces.ds_d: Gucuruza nta mafaranga: gushakisha umuguzi, kumenya igiciro gikwiye, kubahiriza amategeko.
s.p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping ni uburyo bwo kugurisha ibicuruzwa ukoresheje ikoranabuhanga, aho umucuruzi aba akeneye ko umukiriya agura ibyo bicuruzwa akabitumiza ku muguzi.
s.p.espaces.ds_s1: Guhitamo ibicuruzwa byemewe mu gihugu cy’abakiliya bawe: nta bihimbano, nta bicuruzwa bigenzurwa bidafite uburenganzira.
s.p.espaces.ds_s2: Gushaka umucuruzi (ahandi cyangwa ku mbuga z’abacuruzi) no gusaba ishusho mbere yo kugurisha.
s.p.espaces.ds_s3: Gushakisha ibiciro by’ukuri: igicuruzwa, ingendo, imisoro y’imipaka, VAT mu gihugu cy’umukiriya, amafaranga yo kwishyura no gusubiramo.
s.p.espaces.ds_s4: Nsobanurire abaguzi bawe igihe cyo kuhageza ibicuruzwa.
s.p.espaces.ds_s5: Ishyiraho ibikorwa byawe: status y’ishoramari, IVA n’imisoro mu gihugu cyawe (reba amabwiriza y’ubucuruzi).
s.p.espaces.ds_s6: Remera uburenganzira bw'abaguzi: ibiciro bisobanutse, harimo imisoro, uburenganzira bwo gusubiramo, ubwishingizi, ubuziranenge bw'amakuru.
s.p.espaces.ds_w1: Umucuruzi ushaka kwishyura amafaranga yose akoresheje ihererekanya ry’amafaranga ridafite umutekano cyangwa mu mafaranga ya crypto.
s.p.espaces.ds_w2: Ibizamini bishyurwa biguha icyizere cyo kuba umukire vuba.
s.p.espaces.ds_w3: Amafoto yanyerejwe n’amasesengura y’ibinyoma: bitemewe kandi byakagombye guhanwa.
s.p.espaces.ds_w4: Mu muryango w’ubumwe bw’u Burayi, ku butumwa buturutse hanze y’uyu muryango hacibwa VAT kuva ku mbere euro.
s.p.espaces.ds_plat: Imigabane y’abacuruzi b’ingano (ya gisirikari, itandukanye na 24/24 ONE WORLD)
s.p.espaces.bo_d: Indangaciro, amasoko y’imari, amafaranga, ibikomoka kuri peteroli n’ibicuruzwa bikozwe mu ikoranabuhanga byo hirya no hino ku isi, hamwe n’amashusho.
s.p.espaces.bo_sub: Ibiciro bitangwa ku buntu na TradingView, rimwe na rimwe n’igihe gito gikurikije isoko ry’imari.
s.p.espaces.bo_priv: Iyo ukanda kuri iyi tombola, ibiciro bitangira kuva ku rubuga rwa TradingView (urubuga rw'imbere mu gihugu), mu gace kagenewe gusa abantu batabonana na konti yawe.
s.p.espaces.bo_chart: Ishusho y’ishoramari (gushakisha izina ryayo mu rwego rwo hejuru ry’ishusho)
s.p.espaces.bo_risk: 24/24 ONE WORLD ntitanga amabwiriza, nta mafaranga ikoresha kandi ntitanga inama zo gushora imari. Kugura cyangwa kugurisha, ugomba gukoresha umuhuzabikorwa w’imari ufite uburenganzira bwo gukora mu gihugu cyawe.
s.p.espaces.bo_amf: Listes noires de l’AMF (France): sites web de trading, Forex et crypto non autorisés
s.p.espaces.bo_fail: Ibiciro ntibyari bishoboka. Reba niba ukoresha internet neza maze ujye ugerageza.
s.p.espaces.b_none: Niba uri umunyamuryango, ujye ushyiraho uwa mbere!
s.p.espaces.b_ttl_ph: Ibinyabiziga by’umujyi, mu buryo bwiza cyane
s.p.espaces.b_safety: 24/24 ONE WORLD ihuza abantu kandi ntigira uruhare mu bucuruzi, ni ukuvuga ko nta n’umwe ushobora kugura cyangwa kugurisha ibintu byawe.
s.p.espaces.av_invite_sub: Ushobora no gusangira urubuga rwawe: abagukunda bahita bakubona muri Messages.
s.p.espaces.av_soon: Biteganijwe vuba: igabanuka ry’ibiciro rigenewe abakoresha gusa ryashyizweho umukono n’abafatanyabikorwa bacu.
s.p.espaces.need_account: Gutangira, ugomba gukora konti yawe ya burebure muri Messages.
s.p.espaces.e_net: Nta mubano uhari na seriveri. Reba noneho.
s.p.espaces.e_rate: Inyandiko nyinshi cyane ku gihe kimwe: tegereza.
s.p.espaces.report_done: Thank you: raporo yatumiwe ku muyobozi.
s.p.espaces.block_q: Block {n}? Ntabwo uzabona amabaruwa yabo, hano cyangwa muri Messages.
s.p.espaces.entraide_sub: Niba ukeneye gufashwa, ushobora kumusaba, ukamuha ibyo utakoresha: ni byiza kandi bigufasha, n’isi yose, buri wese mu rurimi rwe.
s.p.espaces.h_none: Niba ushaka gutanga umusanzu wawe, uzabe uwa mbere wo kubwira abandi.
s.p.espaces.h_ttl_ph: e.g. Nshaka umuntu ushobora kunfasha mu kubaza ibibazo by'ikinyarwanda
s.p.espaces.h_safety: Gufashanya ni byiza: nta muntu ukwiye kugusaba amafaranga, kurebana mu rugo, kuvugana n’uwo mwashakanye, no gutanga amakuru y’ihohotera (er).
s.p.espaces.sos_sub: Niba ufite ikibazo gikomeye, ubanza uhamagara inzego z’ubutabazi. Aba ni abakozi b’imiryango itari iya Leta.
s.p.espaces.sos_women: Ihohoterwa rikorerwa abagore (gukurikirana, ku buntu, mu buryo butemewe)
s.p.espaces.sos_deaf: Ubutumwa bwo guhamagara mu gihe cy’impanuka (abantu bafite ubumuga bw’uruhu cyangwa abantu batazi kuvuga)
s.p.espaces.sos_112: U Rwanda ntirugaragara muri uru rutonde: ku murongo wa terefoni 112 ukora mu bihugu byinshi, reka turebe niba ari umubare w’ibanze.
s.p.espaces.sos_phr_sub: Insanganyamatsiko zihindurwa mu rurimi rw’igihugu wafashe.
s.p.espaces.sp5: Ni he haherereye ikigo nderabuzima gito cyane?
s.p.espaces.sos_med: 🩺 Ku muganga cyangwa mu iduka ry’imiti
s.p.espaces.hp2: Niba mfite agahinda gakabije ku miti.
s.p.espaces.hp6: Ntacyo nsobanukiwe. Waba ushobora kubishyira mu nyandiko, ndagusaba?
s.p.espaces.sos_offline: Nta n’uburyo bwo guhuza imvugo zishobora guhindurwa: garagaza amanota hejuru.
s.p.papier.title: 📄 Gusobanukirwa a document
s.p.papier.sub: Ufata amafoto y’inyandiko, imiti, impapuro cyangwa amashusho: usome mu rurimi rwawe. Ushobora no gusoma mu ndimi z’amahanga.
s.p.papier.private: Ifoto iguma kuri telefone yawe, gusa ni umurongo wasomye uzajya ujyanwa ku rubuga rw’inyandiko zihindurwa.
s.p.papier.first: Ku nshuro ya mbere kuri iyi ndimi: telefone ikuraho amakuru yo gusoma (amwe mu MB).
s.p.papier.none: Nta nyandiko yabonetse. Reba ishusho, mu buryo busanzwe n’umuriro mwinshi.
s.p.papier.e_lib: Gusoma ntibyoroshye gutangira: inshuro ya mbere ikeneye Internet. Reba uko wakwihuza.
s.p.papier.e_tr: Ihinduranya ntiryabasha gukorwa (ikoranabuhanga cyangwa umubare w'amasaha). Reba.
s.p.papier.warn: Ururimi rw’ikinyarwanda: mu gihe ufite dosiye ikomeye (urukiko, indwara, amafaranga, uburenganzira bwo kubaho), ugomba kubanza kuyisuzuma n’umuntu wizera cyangwa n’ishyirahamwe.
